overall: The AG found the Boxborough Finance Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law: notice was timely posted, and the chair's factual questions at a Select Board meeting were not deliberation, so no meeting occurred. Reminder on joint-meeting notices only.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to post notice for an August 15 joint meeting with the Select Board.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee timely posted notice of “a possible quorum” at the Board’s August 15 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee's August 15 notice for a possible quorum at a Select Board meeting listed no topics, so it was insufficient.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee members did not deliberate, no meeting occurred for purposes of the Open Meeting Law and the notice therefore cannot be insufficient.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that a quorum of Committee members deliberated outside a properly posted meeting when the chair spoke and asked questions at the Select Board meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We conclude that the Committee did not deliberate, and therefore did not hold a meeting subject to the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
